reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value at line 43 is http://<user-host>/api opened via URL.openStream(). User input flows from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') → param → host → fetchHttpByHostname(host). Although isNonPublicAddress() performs some validation, it only blocks loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local addresses. It does not prevent SSRF to cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), internal networks beyond those categories, or DNS-based attacks. Attacker-controlled host parameter reaches the outbound fetch sink expression.
